The deeply emotional Umamusume, Winning 
Ticket. Ever since watching the Nippon 
Derby, she dreamed of becoming an 
Umamusume who could move others to tears—

Alongside her rivals Narita Taishin and 
Biwa Hayahide, she spent her days training 
and pushing each other to greater heights.

And so began our days aiming for the 
Japanese Derby alongside Winning Ticket!
